name: Go Nuts for Donuts
summary: Simultaneous-pick donut draft where colliding picks bust and unique picks score points.
rules_text: Set up a row of N+1 face-up donut cards where N is player count, numbered 1 to N+1 left to right, from a shuffled deck filtered by player count. Each player holds selection cards 1 to N+1. Each round all players secretly choose a row position and reveal simultaneously. Resolve positions in ascending order: if two or more players chose the same number, that donut is discarded with no one getting it. If exactly one player chose it, that player takes it face-up to their score pile. Some donuts are action cards that trigger immediately when taken from the row in number order, letting you steal, draw, or manipulate cards; powers do not trigger when gained other ways. After resolving, refill empty row spots in order from the deck and return selection cards to hands. Continue until the deck cannot fully refill the row, then total points on collected donuts. Most points wins, tie-break most cards.
rating_reason: Simultaneous donut selection with collision is pure bluff
